selection_rule: Committed P18 rule: first four sorted train scenarios after excluding eight previously instruction-exposed scenarios; variant 1; no substitution based on contents or results.
server_lease_basis: Existing identical 64K single-slot M3 server, bounded 28800 seconds from 05:00:13 UTC; verify actual supervisor lease before launch. Start only after P17 completion with at least 8100 seconds remaining.
scope: Four additional development scenarios, one seed each, P11 full-history baseline. Natural failure discovery, not a new-method comparison or independent confirmation.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same model, public tool access, executor prompt, history rendering, seed and per-trial budgets as P11.
All four ID-selected unseen scenarios retained, including successes. No hidden solution, target list or difficulty label supplied.
No memory generation or P17 contract update is used in this full-history arm.
AppWorld is isolated simulation only; public instructions do not authorize real financial, file or account actions.
No concurrent heavy inference with P17. Final evaluation stays separate and is never supplied to later model requests.
Boundary DB/harness snapshots do not claim full process/RNG/cache restoration.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
